prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. A corrected individual ARC Daily Card Cabinet CYBERPUNK GPU-ENGINEER portrait, matching the established Jean-François Puget / Dries illustrated character family. This is the modern cyberpunk treatment, NOT the retro pulp conversion. Input1 is THIS PERSON's own photograph and is the ONLY facial identity source. Input2 is Puget's established illustrated card for the integrated face machinery, huge GPU equipment, hand-rendered facial planes and coherent illustration language ONLY. Never borrow Puget's facial features, age, beard, hair or costume verbatim. Ignore all writing, branding, historic scores, ranks and labels in reference2.
Preserve the exact source person's facial structure, age, skin tone, hair, facial hair and characteristic expression. REPAINT the face in the same richly detailed cinematic comic/painterly medium as the headgear, neck and body. Fine inked contours and painted skin planes; no isolated photographic face on an illustration, no pasted-on head, no anime, no uncanny smoothing or generic superhero face. Facial cybernetics are substantial, anatomically fitted and visibly bolted together: optical unit at the brow/eye, ear receiver/temple frame, cheek communications hardware, hinged lower jaw or collar supports, cables entering suit/compute rig. Keep enough natural face visible for recognition. Strong structural integration of head, neck, shoulders and actual compute hardware. Equipment, coolants and powers are editorial fantasy, no claim about real methods or budget.
A striking varied oversize graphics-card rig with clearly identifiable cooling fans, exposed PCB edges, heat sinks, copper coolant pipes, plugs and tiny multicolored ARC square-grid screens; no generic jeweled fantasy armor. Rich tactile black/metal/fabric materials, cinematic cyan/amber rim lighting, grand ARC scoring-hall environment. Head-to-waist glamour portrait, face near upper third. Keep whole headgear, hands and essential props inside frame. Full bleed portrait5:7, ideally1500x2100, calmer darker lower quarter for code-added card stats later. NO text, logos, digits, names, ranks, medals, title, watermark, border or frame. One person only. No retro halftone paper or pulp space suit; maintain the previously established cyberpunk illustration family. Preserve the actual man from source: short fair/light-brown hair, broad forehead, prominent ears, long angular clean-shaven face, light eyes and friendly toothy smile. Distinct white ceramic and cobalt head rig with a small transparent cyan optical lens mounted on a pivoting brow arm above ONE eye, side temple circuit boards and circular ear sensors, finely bolted cheek struts that descend into neck frame. Don't occlude his smile or transform face into a generic handsome stranger. Cobalt/white brushed-metal cyber-engineer flight suit, massive offset open-cage GPU cooling assembly behind shoulders with wide silver fins and diagonal blue coolant hoses, big detachable graphics-card board mounted as a forearm console showing geometric ARC squares. One gloved finger places a small orange tile. Cool clean lab-like scoring-hall light; no duplicated twin-shoulder armor or borrowed Puget beard.
